subtitle: Epic Games friends and friend requests of the selected account.
no-account: Select an account to see its friends

search.placeholder: Search by name or account ID

empty.friends: This account has no friends yet

reject.title: Reject friend request?
reject.description: The request from {{name}} will be removed.

cancel.title: Cancel friend request?
cancel.description: The request sent to {{name}} will be removed.

remove.title: Remove friend?
remove.description: {{name}} will be removed from the Epic Games friends of {{account}}.

block.title: Block player?
block.description: {{name}} will be removed from friends and requests and blocked on {{account}}. You can unblock them later from the Blocked tab.

accept.title: Accept all friend requests?
accept.description_one: {{count}} friend request will be accepted on {{account}}.
accept.description_other: {{count}} friend requests will be accepted on {{account}}.

reject.title: Reject all friend requests?
reject.description_one: {{count}} friend request will be rejected on {{account}}.
reject.description_other: {{count}} friend requests will be rejected on {{account}}.

cancel.title: Cancel all sent friend requests?
cancel.description_one: {{count}} friend request sent from {{account}} will be cancelled.
cancel.description_other: {{count}} friend requests sent from {{account}} will be cancelled.

confirm.note: It applies to the whole list, not only the search results. There is a one second wait between requests, and you can stop it at any time.
